dish.title: Italian Chicken Cacciatore with Peppers, Mushrooms, and Crusty Bread
dish.description: Bone-in chicken thighs browned and braised hunter-style with bell peppers, onion, cremini mushrooms, garlic, rosemary, red wine, tomatoes, and olives until fall-off-the-bone tender. Served with crusty bread for the sauce.

recipe_version.title: Italian Chicken Cacciatore with Peppers, Mushrooms, and Crusty Bread
recipe_version.description: Bone-in chicken thighs browned and braised hunter-style with bell peppers, onion, cremini mushrooms, garlic, rosemary, red wine, tomatoes, and olives until fall-off-the-bone tender. Served with crusty bread for the sauce.

ingredients.name: crusty bread
ingredients.display_name: crusty bread whose label lists no milk, butter, egg, soy, or sesame

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Pat the chicken dry and season with the salt and pepper. Slice the onion, cut the peppers into strips, quarter the mushrooms, slice the garlic, and chop the parsley.

steps.title: Brown the chicken
steps.body: Heat the olive oil in a 5-quart Dutch oven over medium-high. Brown the thighs skin side down in two batches until deep golden, about 6 minutes, then 2 minutes on the other side. Transfer to a plate and pour off all but 2 tbsp fat.

steps.title: Cook the vegetables
steps.body: Lower the heat to medium. Cook the onion, peppers, and mushrooms, scraping up the browned bits, until softened and the mushrooms release their liquid, about 8 minutes. Add the garlic and rosemary for 1 minute.

steps.title: Deglaze
steps.body: Pour in the wine and simmer until reduced by half, about 3 minutes.

steps.title: Braise
steps.body: Stir in the tomatoes and olives, nestle the chicken skin side up in the sauce with the skin above the liquid, cover, and simmer gently until the chicken reads 175 F near the bone and is tender, about 35 minutes. Uncover for the last 5 of those minutes to thicken the sauce.

steps.title: Slice the bread
steps.body: While the chicken braises, slice the bread (overlap stated).

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Remove the rosemary stems. Serve the chicken with plenty of sauce and vegetables, scatter the parsley, and pass the bread.
